meta.name: 038_opening_range_both_sides
meta.hyp: A bug correction, not a new hypothesis. R4.2's 00:00 UTC opening-range break returned a (long, short) tuple where every trigger returns one signed array, so `recipe()` read 'either side fired' as LONG and the whole of Exp 022 ran long-only: 798 long trades and 0 short. Its control verdicts (DRIFT, NO_EDGE) stand and the round's conclusion is unchanged, but the structure itself was never actually tested on both sides, and it was the only Round 4 structure whose gross move exceeded the 0.11% cost line (+0.141% of price at 4h). The 00:00 print resets positioning once a day - brackets are rebuilt around it - so its first hour is a level with order flow behind it, and a close outside it is the first moment those brackets are all on the wrong side. This re-test adds what Round 4 did not have: a 6% stop and a 96h hold, so the gross move is measured against a cost of 0.043 R rather than 0.15 R.
